answer: Anchor every new identity to its funding source. The registry traces the wallet cluster that paid the registration fee and prices the next identity from the same cluster quadratically: the first pays one unit, the second four, the third nine. The fee is locked as a bond, released only after a season of honest work, so a velvet onboarding story cannot hide a sable farm. A Sybil operator funding fifty puppets faces thousands of units in sunk cost before earning anything, while one honest agent pays once and keeps working. Splitting wallets restarts the audit trail and forfeits the bond.
